description: This file defines a mock class SearchEngineMock that extends the SearchEngine class. It provides mock implementations of search methods used for testing search functionalities within the SuiteCRM's Search namespace, specifically overriding the search and searchAndDisplay methods.

classes.name: SearchEngineMock
classes.description: A mock subclass of SearchEngine used for testing search functionalities, providing stubbed responses based on input queries.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a mock search based on the query's search string, returning results accordingly with simulated timing.

methods.name: searchAndDisplay
methods.description: Performs a search and outputs the total number of results.
